description: This file contains C code that creates an XML data model structure using functions like DMPackCreatePNode, DMPackCreateNode, DMPackCreateObject, and DMPackCreateFunctions. It appears to be part of a larger system involving data model packaging and has references to external functions for XML node creation and data model configuration.

methods.name: PVOID DMPackCreateDataModelXML()
methods.description: Creates and returns an XML node object representing a data model info structure with version, module name, and nested objects including hotspot-specific parameters.
